panels.description: Total variation distance between the prior-hour baseline and recent hour. Scores at or above 0.20 indicate drift under the worker configuration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, rating_drift_tvd AS "Rating TVD", event_type_drift_tvd AS "Event-type TVD" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Rolling Distribution Drift

panels.description: Rating events in the recent one-hour comparison window. A TVD score is null until both rating windows meet the configured minimum sample count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, rating_drift_sample_count AS "Recent rating events" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Rating Drift Sample Size

panels.description: Total events in the adjacent baseline and recent one-hour windows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, COALESCE((event_type_baseline_counts->>'watch')::bigint, 0) + COALESCE((event_type_baseline_counts->>'rating')::bigint, 0) + COALESCE((event_type_baseline_counts->>'account_created')::bigint, 0) AS "Baseline events", COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'watch')::bigint, 0) + COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'rating')::bigint, 0) + COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'account_created')::bigint, 0) AS "Recent events" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Event Window Volume

panels.description: Share of recent events by the normalized stream event type.

targets.rawSql: WITH counts AS (SELECT window_end, COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'watch')::double precision, 0) AS watch, COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'rating')::double precision, 0) AS rating, COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'account_created')::double precision, 0) AS account_created FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes') SELECT window_end AS time, watch / NULLIF(watch + rating + account_created, 0) AS "Watch", rating / NULLIF(watch + rating + account_created, 0) AS "Rating", account_created / NULLIF(watch + rating + account_created, 0) AS "Account created" FROM counts ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Recent Event Composition

panels.description: Most recent baseline and recent counts, including zero-count event types.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((event_type_baseline_counts->>'watch')::bigint, 0) AS "Baseline watch", COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'watch')::bigint, 0) AS "Recent watch", COALESCE((event_type_baseline_counts->>'rating')::bigint, 0) AS "Baseline rating", COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'rating')::bigint, 0) AS "Recent rating", COALESCE((event_type_baseline_counts->>'account_created')::bigint, 0) AS "Baseline accounts", COALESCE((event_type_recent_counts->>'account_created')::bigint, 0) AS "Recent accounts" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest Event Counts

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(generated_at)))::double precision AS "Seconds since success" FROM monitoring_runs
